company.name: Version Story Compare
company.shortDescription: Deterministic redlining at scale — now within Claude
company.description: Version Story is the primary utility layer for agentic legal workflows. As tokens flow like water, Version Story provides deterministic redlining infrastructure that gives the trust layer shape. Claude searches, summarizes, and creates. Version Story validates.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for comparing, redlining, and managing versions of legal documents, supporting Word and PDF formats with merge and export capabilities.
productsAndServices.name: Version Story Redlining and Version Control Platform

productsAndServices.description: A feature that organizes and visually displays the full history and versions of legal documents to provide clarity and easy navigation through drafts and edits.
productsAndServices.name: Version Story Document Version Organization and History Visualization

productsAndServices.description: A tool to consolidate multiple document drafts into a single version by automatically detecting and resolving conflicting edits from different contributors.
productsAndServices.name: Version Story Merge and Conflict Resolution

productsAndServices.description: Integrations with document management and office tools such as iManage, NetDocuments, SharePoint, Word, and Outlook to streamline legal document workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Version Story Integrations with Legal and Office Systems
